title: Wedding coin, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Original design and elegant packaging Unconventional gift for newlyweds Valuable souvenir made of fine silver Talisman that will bring luck to your marriage The „Wedding Coin” is a perfect gift that will surprise everyone and bring a smile to the bride and groom’s faces. It is a fairy-tale classic that expresses all the best wishes on a new path of life together. When looking for wedding gifts, it is worth getting something unconventional. This silver coin in an elegant case will make an unforgettable souvenir, bringing happiness and love to the young couple forever.
